periods.label: Mon 9 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 20 knots, reaching up to 25 knots offshore north of Moruya Heads in the late afternoon. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres offshore. Southeasterly 3 metres. Large and powerful surf conditions for the rest of the day are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing, particularly for south to southeast facing beaches.
